notes: mGBA (Game Boy, Game Boy Color, Game Boy Advance): pkgforge-dev's sharun repackaging of mGBA 0.10.5 (Qt frontend).

-f: fullscreen. -C key=value: per-launch overrides mGBA never saves; mGBA has ONE save and save-state folder, so each system's card passes its own (~/saves/<system>, ~/states/<system>). -- ends options.

mGBA does not quit when a game stops (no batch mode) and cannot bind a button combination, so it has no pad exit: OpenGamepadUI's Exit (Guide) closes it (SIGTERM ends it at once, no dialog; the .sav is written 15 frames after the game saves). A launcher-side Select + Start may come later (user decision 2026-10-06: not R3, too easy to hit).
gui_args: mGBA's own window (touch screen; the Qt frontend has no pad-driven UI).
